verdict.rationale: Model management, saved prompts and per-model configurations are a fair question for a local LLM runtime that ships a CLI, server and web UI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows that models can be pulled with `-hf` and served through a built-in web UI. Nothing in the pack documents a unified place to manage downloaded models, save prompts or store per-model configurations.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place
